propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep spawns one git log --full-history walk per ticket inside the store write lock, blocking all writers for minutes; the deployed reality was worse — per-ticket map misses fell through to per-event wildcard walks with full-history scans

History walk must be hoisted out of the lock and performed once per sweep using a position-keyed map (build_position_commit_map, not the path-keyed build_introducing_commit_map which would silently restore per-event walks)
The _commit_backfill staging must be scoped to folded paths (git add -- {tid}/) instead of git add -A to prevent concurrent writers' uncommitted events from being swept into the compaction commit
The sweep must re-probe write_lock_is_busy between tickets in compact_all_cli's loop to allow mid-run yields when writers arrive, rather than probing once before the entire run

The new optional position-map parameter to _build_authorship_ledger must default to None for backward compatibility with compact_rebuild.py:160 and existing test call sites that pass arguments positionally
